verdicts.reason: Both candidates take the tall portrait stack, shrink it, and drop it into the middle of a 320x50 strip instead of rearranging it as a left-to-right banner. The headline, body copy and 'Reserve a Case' button are microscopic and unreadable, and wide empty navy panels fill both sides. A at least keeps the logo visible in the white band. In B the white band looks empty with no logo, and the headline stack has an odd gap, so B is slightly worse.
